title: CPS Less PvP
body:
CPSLessPvP is a lightweight plugin designed to enhance the PvP experience on your server. It removes the attack cooldown that was introduced in recent Minecraft updates, allowing players to click at any speed (high CPS) without being limited by a cooldown.

In addition to this core feature, the plugin also specifically targets and eliminates the cooldown on items such as ender pearls, enabling players to use them back-to-back without any delay. This creates a faster, more fluid combat environment reminiscent of older Minecraft versions.

Perfect for PvP servers, minigames, or anyone who wants a more classic combat feel. Just install the plugin and the changes will be applied to all players immediately.
